title: Sequin Mermaid Cap Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shine bright like a star in this stunning evening dress! Featuring shimmering sequins, elegant cap sleeves, and a figure-flattering silhouette, this gown is perfect for making a glamorous entrance at any formal event or special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequins.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
